name: SUMI
recent: 公司近期有多项公司秘书及注册地址变更公告，属于行政层面调整。新闻方面，并提到油气行业趋势对公司业务的影响。最新财报显示营收和净利均同比增长。
notable: RHB Research 发布研究报告，给予公司 14 仙公允价值，并认为有 40% 上行空间。
公司出现在 Bursa Malaysia 2025 年 4 月至 2026 年 9 月期间五家 Bumiputera 公司上市的报道中。
新闻提及公司将从油气行业的积极趋势中受益。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 6 月 30 日季度，营收为 MYR 45.116 million，同比增长 22.3%，环比增长 7.0%；净利为 MYR 4.414 million，同比增长 252.3%，环比增长 76.4%；净利率为 9.8%，高于上一季度的 5.9%。

recent_en: The company recently announced several changes of company secretary and registered address, which are administrative adjustments. In the news, a research report assigned a fair value to the company and mentioned the impact of oil and gas industry trends on its business. The latest financial results show year-on-year growth in both revenue and net profit.
notable_en: The company was mentioned in a report on five Bumiputera companies listed on Bursa Malaysia between April 2025 and September 2026.
News mentioned that the company is set to gain from positive trends in the oil and gas sector.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 45.116 million, up 22.3% year-on-year and 7.0% quarter-on-quarter; net profit was MYR 4.414 million, up 252.3% year-on-year and 76.4% quarter-on-quarter; net margin was 9.8%, higher than 5.9% in the previous quarter.
